heads.en: The director of the 10 colleagues who have been examined for the hot-smoking "side-breathing" show, Jacey Birch, anchor of Miami WPLG TV, recently released several photographs of the exterior of her chest on community platforms at a concert entitled "Electrich Daisy Carnival" in Orando, Florida, which raised questions about the irregularities in management.
